source_topic: Largest eigenvalue of a symmetric matrix

follow_up.question: Why are the sum direction (1,1) and difference direction (1,-1) useful?
follow_up.reference: They are orthogonal eigenvector directions for this symmetric matrix. After normalising them, every unit vector has a score that is a weighted average of the two eigenvalues. The maximum is the larger eigenvalue.

What is the largest score you can achieve?

follow_up.question: Why are the sum direction (1,1) and difference direction (1,-1) useful?
follow_up.reference: They are orthogonal eigenvector directions for this symmetric matrix. After normalising them, every unit vector has a score that is a weighted average of the two eigenvalues. The maximum is the larger eigenvalue.
